svg.title: The toy QPU: qudits, controllers, lines and the decoder link
svg.desc: Diagram of the toy QPU. 3 qudits at 5, 5.3, 5.6 GHz and 2 toy.sequencer controllers: controller 0 drives qudits 0 and 1, and one feedline reads qudits 0 and 1; controller 1 drives qudit 2, and a readout line reads qudit 2. An outcome takes 40 cycles from one controller to the other. The decoder link of the control system, drawn to both controllers, takes 4 ns out and 8 ns back. The reference clock is 250 MHz and the program clock 1 GHz.
